notes.title: Suggested Changes!
notes.content:
Some suggested changes have come to Kitball 20000!

[list]
[*]Player now turns the same speed universally, regardless of Controller or Mouse DPI.
[*]Enemy movements are slightly slowed, and enemy fire rates are more telegraphed.
[*]When the player dies in Single Player, the camera now shows briefly what defeated them.
[*]Added the ability to optionally control characters using only keyboard (Left/Right arrows to turn).
[*]Game over screen now slightly shortened.
[*]Can no longer pause during victory/defeat screens and starting countdown.
[*]Exploding enemy's shots are slower.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone that let me know what they felt needed changed!  I'm happy to do so if it means a better experience for everyone!  With that said, if anyone has further suggestions, I'm all ears and would love to hear them in the comments!

Thank you and stay proper!
